name: Anchorage
tagline: Gateway to Alaska's glaciers, bears and Denali
summary: Anchorage is Alaska's largest city, between the Chugach Mountains and Cook Inlet. Learn about Alaska Native cultures, cycle the coastal trail, then drive the Seward Highway to glaciers and Kenai Fjords, or take the train to Denali to see the continent's highest peak.
seasonNote: June to August brings midnight sun and wildlife; winter offers northern lights.
arrival: Ted Stevens Anchorage International is 15 minutes from downtown.
gettingAround: Rent a car; the Alaska Railroad for Seward and Denali.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants. Sales tax is added at the till.
foodTip: Wild salmon, halibut and reindeer sausage.
buyTip: Alaska Native crafts with the Silver Hand mark.
